_comment: Run-of-show templates. Edit freely between broadcasts; a race copies its
rundown when the show starts, so edits mid-show won't disturb a live one.
name     what the casters and the overlay call it
minutes  planned length; the overlay counts down and shows overruns
kind     'game' for the race itself, which switches the overlay to
turn count and live tallies. Anything else is talk.
action   optional. 'open' opens betting when the segment starts,
'lock' locks it. Move 'lock' later if you want betting to
stay open through the first few turns.
